exercises.title: Scales 1 — importance × urgency
exercises.problemHtml:
Wiegers Figure 16-1: High = important and urgent; Medium = important but not urgent; Low = neither important nor urgent; and the fourth quadrant — urgent to some stakeholder but not important to the business objectives — don’t do it. Classify the requirements for the next ClinicCare release.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Hình 16-1: High = quan trọng + gấp; Medium = quan trọng, không gấp; Low = không quan trọng, không gấp; ô thứ tư — gấp với ai đó nhưng không quan trọng với mục tiêu — đừng làm.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Scales 2 — multipass, MoSCoW and $100
exercises.problemHtml:
Multipass (Figure 16-2): if too many requirements are High, partition the Highs again into high / higher / highest; the "highest" become the new top, the rest fold into Medium. MoSCoW turns three levels into four but gives no rationale for rating and is ambiguous about timing ("Won’t" — this release or ever?) — the book prefers the importance × urgency scale. $100: each participant spends 100 imaginary dollars; it makes people think about limited resources but is easy to game and ignores implementation cost.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Scales 3 — run a $100 vote and spot gaming
exercises.problemHtml:
Each participant spends exactly $100 across the features. Write function hundredDollar(ballots) where ballots is an array of { voter, alloc: { featureId: dollars } }. Return { totals, ranking, invalid, gamed }:

  • invalid: voters whose allocation does not sum to exactly 100, or contains a negative or non-integer amount — their ballots are not counted.
  • totals: dollars per feature from valid ballots.
  • ranking: feature ids by total (highest first); ties alphabetical.
  • gamed: valid voters who put more than $60 on a single feature (a warning, they are still counted).

invalid and gamed keep the ballot order.

Requirements

  • Davis: the $100 method is easy to game — flag it, do not silently trust it.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mỗi người chi đúng $100. Viết hundredDollar(ballots) trả { totals, ranking, invalid, gamed }: phiếu không đủ đúng 100, có số âm hoặc không nguyên ⇒ invalid và không tính; totals theo tính năng; ranking giảm dần, hoà theo bảng chữ cái; gamed = người dồn hơn $60 vào một tính năng (vẫn được tính).

Yêu cầu

  • Davis: $100 dễ bị lách — cần cảnh báo, đừng tin mù quáng.
hintsJson: Kiểm phiếu trước (tổng đúng 100, số nguyên không âm), rồi mới cộng.
